rules.title: General prohibition of local rent control; exception
rules.requirement: No city or town may enact, maintain or enforce rent control of any kind. A city or town that accepts the chapter may adopt rent control only if compliance becomes voluntary after six months, it does not regulate occupancy, services, evictions, condominium conversion or removal of properties, it does not apply to units owned by a person or entity owning less than ten rental units or with a fair market rent exceeding $400, and the municipality compensates owners from general funds.
rules.coverage_text: Applies to every city or town in the Commonwealth. It limits what local rent control regulation may do.
rules.exemptions: A city or town that accepts this chapter may adopt rent control regulation, but only on the stated conditions. Such regulation may not apply to any rental unit owned by a person or entity owning less than ten rental units, or to a unit with a fair market rent exceeding $400.
rules.citation: General Laws Part I, Title VII, Chapter 40P, Section 4
